order_note: No predecessor and no order on this engine. SQL 111 needs public.tenants (with the referral columns of the restored Supabase schema), public.referral_events and public.tenant_users owned by checksops_admin without FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (referral_events and tenants), and the AWS identity helpers (auth.uid(), aws_is_authenticated, aws_can_access_tenant, is_platform_owner). Apply it before (or with) the API change that routes apply_referral_code, get_tenant_referral_summary and get_referral_overview to these functions and the billing engine change that reads aws_tenant_referral_credit_cents: until then Refer & Earn cannot redeem a code, and the billing engine's optional read of the credit returns no row, so the maintenance discount stays tenants.referral_discount_cents alone (unchanged behaviour). SQL 111 creates five SECURITY DEFINER functions, EXECUTE checksops only (the active-count helper the owner only). No later migration replaces them.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 111: sql111-tenant-referral-codes-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql111-tenant-referral-codes); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql111. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): each of the five functions' language, volatility, SECURITY DEFINER, result, search_path, body hash and EXECUTE ACL. The pre-conditions also require that the applying login can write public.referral_events and public.tenants as a definer (definer_can_write_relations). The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
